reuse.why: The daily-skip rule is added to the existing shared applyWeekendRule, and frequency is threaded through the existing parseRecurDate data rather than recomputed.

duplication.why: No rule logic is copied; the template's two inline ternaries are folded into one local helper, though each caller handles the new null result and over-fetches occurrences (take 7, count*7) in its own way.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts; the template's getWeekendAdjustedDay helper keeps a redundant skipWeekend check that applyWeekendRule already makes.

scope.why: Only schedule date handling and its tests are touched.

maintainability.why: One function decides move vs skip; the nullable return is documented, though the occurrence over-fetch heuristics are scattered across callers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and the budget template all call applyWeekendRule.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the template's local helper wraps the shared function rather than reimplementing it.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts applyWeekendRule decides skipping daily weekend occurrences for getNextDate, schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and budget/schedule-template createScheduleList.
